title: 10 VERY Useful Things I Wish I Knew Sooner in RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0
author: GamerCory
description:
10 SUPER useful things I wish I knew sooner in RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0.

After putting a lot more time into Dragonwilds, there are a bunch of things I really wish I had understood earlier. Some of these save a ton of time, some save resources, and others completely change how you approach progression.

In this video, I cover 10 useful things that can make your playthrough much easier, including Personal Chest, Sanguine Urns, weapon Ascension, tool tier requirements, the Storage Ledger, crafting from storage, Lodestone costs, Vault Core respawns, Agility carry-weight upgrades, and a much better way to think about progression.

If you're new to RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0 or you're already deep into the game, there should be at least a few things here that can save you time and make progression smoother.

More RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0 guides as I progress through the game — subscribe if you want quick guides without wasting your time.
